terms.p: The public registry cargo downloads dependencies from, where every published version of a crate stays available forever.
The MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH convention crates follow, where only a major bump is allowed to break code that already compiled.
A cargo subcommand that runs several hundred lints beyond the compiler's own, mostly about idiom and needless work.
The standard code formatter, run as `cargo fmt`, which has one style and almost no options so that every Rust codebase looks the same.
